model: SKH (legacy, pre-SKH4) high pressure atomiser - SKH EZC zone controller
applies_to: EZC zone controllers of older Neptronic SKH high pressure atomising humidifiers, before the SKH4; each zone is its own BACnet device.
summary: Each EZC zone controller of an older SKH atomiser system is its own BACnet MS/TP device. It carries the zone demand and output, room and duct humidity and temperature readings, occupied, unoccupied, vacant, internal and network setpoints, network humidity and temperature inputs with a timeout, the control mode and source selectors, stage outputs, cutouts and sensor alarms, and a weekly occupancy schedule.
notes: Objects are grouped as Integrator, Integrator configuration and Advanced; MSV Cfg_ObjectListMode chooses which groups the device shows (Integrator, Advanced or Factory).
Access: "Present Value" in the W? column is listed as writable, "Out of Service" (only the out-of-service property is writable) as read-only; commandable BOs are marked C.
Out-of-service is cleared automatically after 15 minutes by default (Device proprietary property #1002).
The pump station is a separate BACnet device with its own object list (see the SKH pump station list).

source.title: High Pressure Atomiser SKH Series BACnet User Guide

integration.summary: Set MSV 2 Occupancy and BV 2 ZoneMode, choose the control mode (MSV 100) and sources (MSV 101-103). For network control write AV 1 ZoneDemand or the network setpoint and RH (AV 11, AV 13) before the network timeout (AV 102) runs out. Read MSV 1 ZoneState, AV 3 ZoneOutput, AI 4 room RH and the alarm flags.

minimum_points.name: NetworkRH
minimum_points.why: Network room RH from the BMS

integration.enable: BV 2 ZoneMode turns the zone on; MSV 100 Cfg_ControlMode = 5 (Network) hands the demand to the BMS.
integration.heartbeat: AV 102 Cfg_NetworkTimeout (1-15 min) sets how long network values are held; AV 15 counts down and BV 36 AL_NetworkTimeout flags a lapse.
integration.remote_sensors: MSV 101 / 102 = Network take room RH and temperature from AV 13 NetworkRH and AV 14 NetworkTemp; MSV 103 = Network takes the setpoint from AV 11 / AV 12.
setup: Baud rate and device instance can be automatic: the humidifier sets its device instance to 153000 + MAC address; the MAC (0-254) is set from the menu.
Max_Master defaults to 127; lower it for a faster MS/TP trunk.
gotchas: Network values must be refreshed within Cfg_NetworkTimeout (AV 102, 1-15 min) or BV 36 AL_NetworkTimeout is raised.
BV 102 Cfg_NetworkControlOverride is a configuration switch; check it during commissioning.
